tasks.label: Install Dependencies
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m pip install -e .

tasks.label: Install VFB Query Builder
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && rm -rf src/vfb/vfb_query_builder && mkdir -p src/vfb && git clone https://github.com/VirtualFlyBrain/VFB_json_schema.git src/vfb/vfb_query_builder && cd src/vfb/vfb_query_builder && pip install -e .

tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=${workspaceFolder} VISPY_GL=osmesa NAVIS_HEADLESS=1 python -m unittest discover

tasks.label: Run Tests (Skip UI)
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=${workspaceFolder} python -m unittest discover -k 'not test_anat_image_crawling and not test_crawling'
